title: 第1779章 被人强夺霜冻冰焰第1778章 突然出现的三位渡劫期修士
content_zh:
“好大的口气！！！
我万象道盟很久都没有被这样威胁过了。”
突然，又是一道人影出现在炎阳至尊身旁，此人正是灵纹至尊。
那是谁？？？
能够出现在这里的绝对是渡劫期的存在！！
是我道盟的哪位至尊？？？
炎阳圣地内的众多修士见到己方又有一人加入战局，精神顿时一振。
虽然人数上还是占据劣势，但二对三总比一对三有希望。
看外形应该是位女性........
那就排除了空空至尊和万象至尊。
是霓裳至尊和灵纹至尊中的一人吗？？
叶非凡看着来人，已经将身份范围锁定的很小了。
就他所知，万象道盟明面上总共只有五位至尊，至于还有没有其他的渡劫期修士隐藏在暗处就不清楚了。
“不愧是灵纹至尊，竟然还能及时支援过来。”
烬天尊者淡淡的说道。
“让烬天尊者失望了。”
灵纹至尊也是一脸平静。
“失望倒是谈不上，多一个灵纹至尊改变不了什么。”
烬天尊者并未有什么惊慌。
人数上他们毕竟还是占据着优势。

“哈哈哈，炎阳至尊和灵纹至尊要是不服气的话那咱们就打上一场！！”
无畏皇主同样是不惧，甚至主动发起挑衅。
“......”
此刻灵纹至尊反而不好说什么了，毕竟这里是炎阳至尊的主场，一旦五人打起来，炎阳圣地绝对没有好下场。
“霜冻冰焰是我的底线，你们一旦过线，就算拼着炎阳圣地毁于一旦我也会让你们付出相应的代价。
金乌之火将会燃尽你们宗门势力的每一寸土地！”
炎阳至尊沉默片刻后沉声说道。
随着这话一出，万象道盟等于是在这场交锋中败了。
灵纹至尊看了看炎阳至尊，最终还是没有说话。
“多谢炎阳至尊理解。”
烬天尊者点点头，见好就收。
既然主要目的已经达成，那么再继续压榨的话很可能适得其反。
万象道盟中的空空至尊和万象至尊都是极不好惹的存在，真全面交战的话，他们三人还真不一定能够捞到什么好处。
那些之前说好会支持他们的渡劫期修士到时候会出多少力也是个未知数。
“那我这就将霜冻冰焰交给你们。”
“嘿嘿，这个也不用劳烦炎阳至尊亲自动手。
我等既然都能找到炎阳圣地的位置，自然也知道霜冻冰焰在哪，还是让我们自己取来吧。”
荒芜道人嘿嘿一笑，取出自己的灵宝展了开来。
他的灵宝外形是一把伞，在展开后，伞面快速扩张，很快张大到数千米，将他们三人所在的区域覆盖住。
随后伞面下伸出无数蓝色巨手直接对着炎阳圣地的北面区域冲去。

然而下一刻，大量的炎阳金焰从炎阳至尊身上涌现而出，将那些蓝色巨手焚烧殆尽。
“炎阳至尊，你这是何意？”
烬天尊者脸色一沉。
“好好好！！！
那就开打！！！”
content_en:
“What a loud tone!!!
Our Vientiane Dao Alliance has not been threatened like this for a long time. "
Suddenly, another figure appeared next to Yanyang Supreme. This person was none other than Spirit Pattern Supreme.
Who is that? ? ?
Those who can appear here are definitely those in the tribulation period! !
Which supreme member of our Dao Alliance is he? ? ?
Many monks in Yanyang Holy Land were immediately refreshed when they saw another one of their own joining the battle.
Although they are still at a disadvantage in terms of numbers, two versus three is always more promising than one versus three.
Judging from the appearance, she should be a woman...
That excludes the Supreme Being of Nothingness and the Supreme Being of Everything.
Is he one of the Supreme Nichang and the Supreme Spirit Pattern? ?
Ye Feifan looked at the person coming and had already narrowed down his identity.
As far as he knew, there were only five Supremes in the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance on the surface. It was unclear whether there were other monks in the Tribulation Stage hiding in the dark.
"As expected of the Supreme Spirit Pattern, he was able to provide timely support."
Lord Jingtian said calmly.
"I disappoint Venerable Jingtian."
The Supreme Spirit Pattern also looked calm.
"Disappointment is out of the question. One more Spirit Pattern Supreme can't change anything."
Lord Jing Tian did not feel any panic.
After all, they still have the advantage in terms of numbers.
"Hahaha, if Yanyang Supreme and Spirit Pattern Supreme are not convinced, then we will have a fight!!"
The fearless emperor is also unafraid and even initiates provocations.
"..."
At this moment, the Spirit Pattern Supreme had nothing to say. After all, this was Yanyang Supreme's home court. Once the five of them started fighting, Yanyang Holy Land would definitely not end well.
"Frost and ice flames are my bottom line. Once you cross the line, I will make you pay a corresponding price even if I try to destroy the Yanyang Holy Land.
The fire of the Golden Crow will burn every inch of your sect’s power! "
Supreme Yanyang said in a deep voice after a moment of silence.
As soon as these words came out, the Wanxiang Dao Alliance was defeated in this confrontation.
The Spirit Pattern Supreme looked at the Yanyang Supreme, but finally said nothing.
"Thank you, Supreme Yanyang, for your understanding."
Lord Jingtian nodded and stopped as soon as he was satisfied.
Now that the main purpose has been achieved, continuing to squeeze is likely to be counterproductive.
Kongkong Supreme and Wanxiang Supreme in the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance are very difficult to mess with. If they really engage in a full-scale battle, the three of them may not be able to gain any benefits.
It is also unknown how much effort those cultivators in the Tribulation Stage who had promised to support them would contribute at that time.
"Then I will hand over the frost and ice flames to you."
“Hehe, there’s no need to bother Supreme Yanyang to do this himself.
Since we can find the location of the Flame Holy Land, we naturally know where the Frost Ice Flame is, so let’s get it ourselves. "
Taoist Huangwu smiled, took out his spiritual treasure and unfolded it.
The shape of his spirit treasure was an umbrella. After unfolding, the umbrella surface expanded rapidly and soon expanded to thousands of meters, covering the area where the three of them were.
Then countless giant blue hands stretched out from under the umbrella and rushed directly towards the northern area of ​​Yanyang Holy Land.
However, at the next moment, a large amount of Yanyang golden flames emerged from the body of Yanyang Supreme, burning those giant blue hands.
"Supreme Yanyang, what do you mean?"
Lord Jingtian's face darkened.
“Okay okay!!!
Then let the fight begin! ! ! "
